title: Annotate deleted historical paths
capture_reason: Historical evidence needs an explicit degraded annotation instead of silent removal.

content.context: A valid historical claim can refer to a path that no longer exists in the current tree.
content.guidance: Keep the claim only when its historical commit and degraded status are explicit.
content.why_it_matters: Silently deleting the reference destroys useful provenance.
content.boundaries: Current-code claims still require a current repo-relative path and matching quote.
content.examples: Good: historical=true with a commit. Counterexample: treating a missing current path as verified.

claims.statement: The historical implementation lived at a now-deleted path.
